_comment: Copy to config.json and fill in the keys for the packages you run. config.json and config.local.json are both gitignored; put per-machine overrides in config.local.json. Any value can also be set as an env var: SKILLS_<DOTTED_KEY_UPPER>, e.g. SKILLS_DISCORD_CHANNELS_READING_LIST. Secrets (bot tokens, API keys) never go here; see lib/read_secret.py.

paths._comment: data_root is where every skill keeps databases, imports, logs and caches. Defaults to <repo>/_data (gitignored). video_drop is the folder video-tools scans by default; a folder passed on the command line always works without it.

secrets._comment: How lib/read_secret.py finds secrets after the environment: 1Password vault/field, the macOS keychain service prefix, and a flat JSON fallback.

discord._comment: user_id is the numeric id of the person whose reactions the sweeps act on. In Discord: Settings > Advanced > Developer Mode, then right-click your name > Copy User ID. Reactions from anyone else are ignored, so the bot can live in a shared server.

channels._comment: Numeric channel ids. Each package README says which it needs.

accounts._comment: restaurant-assistant: the Google account the Maps browser profile is signed into, and the account the calendar CLI authenticates as.

calendars._comment: restaurant-assistant: the calendar the planner reads for free evenings.

token_tracker._comment: host labels this machine's rows; inbox is an optional drop folder where other machines leave counts-only exports; openai_prices is optional {model: [input, output]} $/MTok for Codex cost.
